question:
Some conditional data is provided to you in form of statement you have to check which of the following statement are logically inference from given statement.

Statement: Every doctor who works at City Hospital has completed a residency program. Dr. Smith works at City Hospital. What can we infer about Dr. Smith?

options.text: Dr. Smith is an experienced doctor
Dr. Smith has completed a residency program
Dr. Smith graduated from medical school

solution:
**Given: **Every doctor who works at City Hospital has completed a residency program. Dr. Smith works at City Hospital.
